_comment: Ported from SIGNS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1201). {S}/{s}/{is}/{es}/{p}/{do}/{o}/{r} are pronoun tokens filled from a sitter's pronoun (he/she/they) at display time — see PRON in the source.

signs.rule: The first card of every reading restores nothing.
A reading of fewer than three cards restores nothing at all.
signs.fl: {S} need{es} it to be a performance.

signs.rule: Whatever you speak last restores half.
signs.fl: {S} interrupt{es} with a story of {p} own.

signs.rule: A wall holds off the first points of every reading — what it holds off wears the wall away, but it thickens 3 again after every one.
A sign already spoken in this reading restores nothing the second time.
One card leaves your hand at random before every reading.
Cards of {p} own sign restore half.
You have one less energy every reading.
Whatever your best card restores is halved.
No card pays its condition — nothing for opening, closing or following.
Nothing is held off the first reading, and the wall thickens 4 after every one.
